node.title: Shopping Cart
node.description: Functional testing suite for the shopping cart, covering add/remove operations, persistence, and cart badge behavior.

node.title: Add single product to cart from inventory
node.description: Validate that a product can be added to the cart from the inventory page.
node.preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user. Cart is empty.
node.postconditions: Cart badge shows 1. Product appears in cart.

node.action: Click "Add to cart" on any product on the inventory page
node.expected_result: Button changes to "Remove". Cart badge displays "1".
Cart page shows the added product with correct name and price.

node.title: Add multiple products to cart
node.description: Validate that multiple products can be added and the cart badge updates correctly.
node.preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user. Cart is empty.
node.postconditions: Cart badge shows correct count. All products appear in cart.

node.action: Click "Add to cart" on 3 different products
node.expected_result: Each button changes to "Remove". Cart badge displays "3".

node.action: Click the cart icon and verify contents
node.expected_result: All 3 products are listed with correct names and prices.

node.title: Remove product from cart via inventory page
node.description: Validate that a product can be removed from the cart using the Remove button on the inventory page.
node.preconditions: User is logged in. One product has been added to the cart.

node.action: Click "Remove" on the previously added product on the inventory page
node.expected_result: Button changes back to "Add to cart". Cart badge disappears.

node.action: Click the cart icon and verify it is empty

node.title: Remove product from cart via cart page
node.description: Validate that a product can be removed directly from the cart page.
node.preconditions: User is logged in. One product has been added to the cart.
node.postconditions: Cart is empty. Inventory button resets to Add to cart.

node.action: Navigate to cart page and click "Remove" on the listed product
node.expected_result: Product is removed. Cart page shows no items.

node.action: Return to inventory and verify the product button shows "Add to cart"
node.expected_result: Button state is consistent with cart being empty.

node.title: Cart contents persist after navigating back to inventory
node.description: Validate that cart contents are maintained when navigating away and returning.
node.preconditions: User is logged in. Two products have been added to the cart.

node.action: Add 2 products to cart, then click "Continue Shopping" to return to inventory
node.expected_result: Cart badge still shows "2". Products still show "Remove" button.

node.action: Click the cart icon to verify contents
node.expected_result: Both products are still listed in the cart.

node.title: Cart is empty on initial login
node.description: Validate that the cart starts empty for a new session.
node.preconditions: User logs in fresh with no previous session.
node.postconditions: Cart badge not visible. Cart page shows no items.

node.action: Login as standard_user and navigate to the cart page immediately
node.expected_result: Cart badge is not visible. Cart page displays "Your cart is empty" or equivalent.

node.title: Proceed to checkout from cart
node.description: Validate that the Checkout button navigates to the checkout flow.
node.preconditions: User is logged in. At least one product is in the cart.
node.postconditions: User is on the checkout information page.

node.action: Navigate to cart page and click the "Checkout" button

node.title: Checkout button disabled on empty cart
node.description: Validate system behavior when attempting checkout with an empty cart.
node.preconditions: User is logged in. Cart is empty.

node.action: Navigate to cart page with no items and click the "Checkout" button
node.expected_result: System prevents checkout or displays a warning message. User is not redirected to checkout step one.
